name: Kenyan bank branches with clearing (bank + branch) codes
source: Kenya Bankers Association: Bank Branch Code list 2026 (Branch-Code-2026.pdf, linked from kba.co.ke/bank-branch-code/)
notes: Single consolidated KBA list (41 pages, PDF created 2026-09-16) covering all 38 commercial banks, HFCB and 4 microfinance banks (KWFT 78, Faulu 79, Caritas 80, Salaam 81); other 10 MFBs have no bank code so no branch codes. Parsed with pdftotext -layout; 2042 rows -> excluded 9 Central Bank of Kenya (09) and 98 Postbank (62) rows (not in banks.csv), 4 exact duplicates and 1 malformed duplicate ('07 33 River Road', same as 07 033). 7 codes appear twice with different names; kept first listed: 03/152 'Absa Imaara Mall' (alt 'Absa Imara Mall'), 07/237 'The Nord, Ruiru Branch' (alt 'The Nord Ruiru'), 31/024 'Kisii' (alt 'Kisii Branch'), 57/040 'Dunga Road' (alt 'Lusaka Road'), 63/024 'BuruBuru Branch' (alt 'Buru Buru'), 68/212 'Gikomba 2 Sub Branch', 74/020 'Mihrab' (alt 'China Town Satellite Branch'). Names kept exactly as KBA spells them (mixed case, some ALL CAPS such as 'KCB GAKOROMONE' left as-is). Extra columns: county_code (3-digit county code as given by KBA), swift_source_url. Branch BICs only for Bank of Baroda (14 branches, mapped by branch name from the bank's own SWIFT page). Spot-checked Absa codes against Absa's own branch-code PDF (match).
